title: LuckRead Public Ingress and Business Terminal Worker Boundary
purpose: Separate public HTTP ingress from authoritative business execution so W01 does not become a universal business owner or mandatory worker-to-worker hop.

rules.ingress: W01 is the public HTTP/API ingress boundary for currently admitted public routes.
rules.terminalAuthority: The Worker listed as terminalWorker is the authoritative business execution boundary for the operation's domain.
rules.noUniversalProxy: W01 must not become a universal business-data proxy or a second authoritative owner.
rules.noReturnToIngress: A Worker-to-Worker call must not be routed back through W01 merely to reach another Worker.
rules.contractRequired: Any W01 ingress-to-terminal hop requires an explicit transport contract with caller, callee, operationId/version, principal provenance, timeout, retry, idempotency, and failure semantics.

routes.authorityNote: W01 owns the public authentication execution boundary only where the admitted Payload-native route is the execution surface; W02 remains the Identity/Account/Authorization authority and receives explicit delegated identity/session mutations.
W03 is the Content/Article/Media/Translation authority and D1-02 owner.
W06 is the Rights/Trust & Safety/Governance authority and D1-03 moderation owner.

workerToWorkerInvariant.forbiddenPattern: business Worker -> W01 -> another business Worker
workerToWorkerInvariant.allowedPattern: public ingress W01 -> contract-declared business terminal Worker
workerToWorkerInvariant.internalPattern: business Worker -> explicitly contracted business Worker where required; W01 is not inserted as a routing hop

nonGoals: No new public namespace is introduced by this contract.
No direct public exposure of W03/W06 is required by this contract.
No Worker or D1 topology expansion.
